verdict.rationale: Lago's plan-model docs show a hybrid structure: a subscription fee plus usage charges billed on separate cadences. Its usage-metering page says non-engineers can update usage charges in a no-code UI. None of the specific pricing models or commercial constructs the story names appear in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented tiered, volume, graduated and per-unit charge models; prepaid credits; minimum commitments; overage handling; independent hands-on corroboration of no-code configuration of these models.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can price with tiered, volume, graduated, per-unit, and hybrid subscription-plus-usage models — including credits, commitments, and overage — without custom code

citations.quote: Yearly: subscription fees are billed on a yearly basis and charges can be billed monthly or annually.
Both non-engineers and engineers can update usage charges via API or Lago’s no-code UI.
